positions.title: AI/ML Engineer
positions.description: Designed and built Agentic AI and multi-agent systems in Python using LLMs for complex planning, analysis, and decision-support use cases, coordinating 5 specialized agents across 12 production workflows to run parallel analysis, critique proposed plans, and consolidate findings into a single recommendation.
achievements: Engineered agent orchestration pipelines with LangChain and LangGraph to route tasks, manage state, and coordinate 15+ integrated tools and APIs through function calling
12% lower hallucination rate from RAG and context-grounding pipelines over 75K+ indexed documents using vector and semantic search
+10% response-quality scores from LLM, agent, and RAG evaluation workflows with LLM-as-a-judge scoring across 40+ scenarios, catching regressions before production
25% less expert review time per output via human-in-the-loop validation that fed structured feedback into iterative agent improvement
Built 150+ adversarial and regression test cases, turning every confirmed failure into a permanent regression case so the same defect could not ship twice
Shipped production AI services behind REST APIs, containerized with Docker and run with LLMOps practices across CI/CD, monitoring, and AI observability

positions.title: Machine Learning Engineer
positions.description: Built machine learning solutions for transportation and logistics spot-market pricing, replacing manual quoting with data-driven freight price recommendations for the pricing business.
achievements: $300K+ in annual savings and +7% bid-win rate from production ML pricing solutions delivered with data engineers, developers, and business stakeholders
15% lower pricing prediction error on held-out validation data through hyperparameter tuning and feature refinement
Engineered features from shipment distance, origin-destination pairs, load characteristics, historical pricing, fuel prices, and seasonality
Integrated predictions into downstream business systems through APIs, enabling automated pricing recommendations for new shipments
Monitored model outputs and data quality in production to detect unusual predictions, data drift, and performance degradation
